headline: DPSC Limited initiates Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; board meeting postponed
sum: DPSC Limited has entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and postponed its management board meeting, as intimated to the National Stock Exchange on 12 August 2026.
implication: The postponement of board meetings during CIRP triggers suspension of ordinary management authority; all material decisions now fall under the Insolvency Professional's remit, requiring partners to monitor IBBI milestones and creditor committee resolutions rather than company-side announcements.
detail: DPSC Limited issued a formal intimation to NSE on 12 August 2026 notifying the market of entry into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, accompanied by notice of postponement of the scheduled board/management meeting. This signals that NCLT has admitted an insolvency petition (either by creditor or operational creditor petition) and an Insolvency Professional has been appointed to conduct the 180-day (extendable) resolution window. Board authority and management control have been vested in the IP during CIRP.

structure.novel: No novel structure; standard CIRP entry under IBC § 5–27. Postponement of board meeting is procedurally required once IP assumes control.
